articles.title: Suit alleges Louisiana land deal between SpaceX and ExxonMobil violates open meetings law
articles.summary_snippet: Suit says parish board was manipulated to allow deal to go through and settlement agreement hidden from public After ending a lawsuit over ExxonMobil ’s damage to wetlands, Louisiana officials moved quickly to approve a deal giving SpaceX access to 125,000 acres (50,600 hectares) of marsh formerly owned by the oil company. A new lawsuit now alleges they did so in violation of the state’s open meetings law. The lawsuit, filed by three south-central Louisiana residents, follows state and Vermilion parish officials’ approval of what is estimated to be a record $27.5bn tax incentive package for SpaceX’s Starbase Louisiana project, announced over the summer . The officials violated the state’s open meetings law eight times while facilitating the agreement in attempts to “keep the public in the dark about what they are doing for SpaceX”, the lawsuit alleges. articles.summary_snippet: The quarterback’s spectacularly messy exit from Pittsburgh could herald an overdue collapse at one of the NFL’s most famous franchises Nobody in the world, except maybe Pittsburgh Steelers owner Art Rooney II, is surprised that the franchise’s marriage of convenience with Aaron Rodgers ended in spectacular flames . articles.title: Why is scandal-plagued Jensen Huang back at Nvidia? – Stateside with Kai and Carter
articles.summary_snippet: Jensen Huang is apparently too big to fail – but what’s that mean for the rest of us? Just last week, Nvidia’s board chair told investors that the company had no intention of reinstating Huang as CEO. On Monday, they turned a full about-face. The board voted unanimously to reinstall Huang, triggering a nearly $1tn surge in the company’s stock market valuation. Donald Trump took credit, telling CNBC that he 'convinced them' to bring Huang back. But questions remain about Huang’s extramarital affair with an alleged Chinese spy, and about whether Nvidia exploited loopholes to export chips to Chinese AI companies.
